data.description: Brandon's call. The one-pipeline bench (docs/model-bench.md) favours Parakeet TDT v2: same CPU and first-word time as Unified now that native streaming is gone, half the errors on long dictation (0.40 vs 0.86 % at 9 min), always ends with a full stop (Unified dropped it on 4 of 13 clips), cleaner word timings for chunk cuts, CC-BY-4.0 license. Against: Unified ranks slightly better on public benchmarks, and TTS clips can't settle that. On approval: switch RECOMMENDED_MODEL and the Offering in models.rs, update display names ('fastest first words', 'recommended'), fetch-model.sh default, DESIGN.md, README.
data.title: Decide the default model: Parakeet TDT v2 or Unified
